title: Tickets | No message tells an agent that the ticket they have open was moved to another department

Says it was moved, by whom and where (Zoho: "<agent> has moved this ticket from … to … department")
"Ticket moved — ndc-staging-owner moved this ticket from Customer Support to Sales. You can no longer open it in its new department." (was a generic "not available")
"Back to the list" (no Stay option: CES2 has no access to Sales, so staying is not possible)
